ety.text: Onomatopoeia of the natural expression of thought. Compare with er.

senses.d: Expression of thought, confusion, or uncertainty.
Expression of discomfort or reservation; a hesitation preceding awkward information or innuendo.
ex: He's receiving some, uh, special attention from the manager.

senses.d: Space filler or pause during conversation.

grp.label: space filler or pause during conversation

fr:euh.gl: er, um, uh; expressing hesitation, reflection, confusion, or doubt

it:boh.gl: used to express doubt or indecision; dunno, idk (in spoken and written language)

es:eh.gl: hey! (used to call, draw attention, warn or reprehend)

es:este.gl: uh, well (space filler in a conversation)

pt:é.gl: Indicates agreement; that's right; yes; yeah.
